bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-dual-delivery-0f3633f"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 71
test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 72
python3 -B - "$root" "$stage" <<'PY'
import re,sys,os
from pathlib import Path
root,stage=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
ipc=root/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
client=root/"scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
a=ipc.read_text();b=client.read_text();incoming=(stage/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py").read_text()
if "bug_report_delivery_smoke" in a:sys.exit(73)
pos=incoming.find('    if action == "bug_report_delivery_smoke":')
end=incoming.find('    if action == "room_private_smoke":',pos)
if pos<0 or end<0:sys.exit(74)
anchor='    if action == "room_private_smoke":'
if a.count(anchor)!=1 or a.count('ACTIONS = frozenset(')!=1:sys.exit(75)
match=re.search(r'^ACTIONS = frozenset\(\{.*\}\)$',a,re.M)
if match is None:sys.exit(76)
new_a=a[:match.end()-2]+', "bug_report_delivery_smoke"'+a[match.end()-2:]
new_a=new_a.replace(anchor,incoming[pos:end]+anchor,1)
old='timeout=90 if request.get("action") == "room_public_post_smoke" else 30'
new='timeout=95 if request.get("action") in {"room_public_post_smoke", "bug_report_delivery_smoke"} else 30'
if new in new_a:pass
elif old in new_a:new_a=new_a.replace(old,new,1)
else:sys.exit(77)
old2='100 if action == "room_public_post_smoke" else 40'
new2='110 if action in {"room_public_post_smoke", "bug_report_delivery_smoke"} else 40'
if old2 not in b:sys.exit(78)
new_b=b.replace(old2,new2,1)
compile(new_a,str(ipc),"exec");compile(new_b,str(client),"exec")
backup=root/"deploy/.userbot-code-backup-20261119"
backup.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
for path,old in ((ipc,a),(client,b)):
 dest=backup/(path.name+".before_report_smoke")
 if dest.exists():sys.exit(79)
 dest.write_text(old)
 dest.chmod(0o600)
for path,new_text in ((ipc,new_a),(client,new_b)):
 tmp=path.with_name(path.name+".report-smoke.tmp")
 if tmp.exists():sys.exit(80)
 tmp.write_text(new_text)
 tmp.chmod(path.stat().st_mode&0o777)
 os.replace(tmp,path)
print("SMOKE_IPC_LOCAL_PATCH_PASS")
PY
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 81
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 82
for i in $(seq 1 20); do test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" && break; sleep 1; done
test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 83
(cd "$root/scripts" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B userbot_test_client.py health) || exit 84
echo USERBOT_REPORT_E2E_READY
